additional_info.body:
Hi,
I did a restart via OCPP earlier today before your email. The reboot was initiated but it took a really long time (>15 mins) and after it had rebooted it was showing a general screen without the option to start a charging session (see attached photo). All I can do is switch between language setting – that’s it. We tried connecting it to a vehicle but there was no communication happening.
At that point it was no longer reachable through our backend so we initiated another hard reboot by removing the power supply at the station directly. The reboot again took very long with the same result.
We will need a technician to come onsite as soon as possible as we need this charger every day and it is the charger with the highest usage in our plant.
Can you please organize the on-site visit asap and prioritize it accordingly?
